description: Updates (or creates) a contact by email/userId. Upserts — creates the contact if not found. Loops API: PUT /v1/contacts/update.

email.description: Contact email address (required; identifies the contact).

mailingLists.description: Map of mailing-list id -> subscribed boolean.

properties.description: Arbitrary custom contact properties (string/number/boolean); merged into the request body.

subscribed.description: Whether the contact is subscribed to email.

name: loops_update_contact
title: Update a contact
